features.name: Project setup and baseline verification
features.description: Install dependencies, verify tests/build, and keep the Vite React app restartable from a clean checkout.
features.evidence: npm test and npm run build passed before harness creation; init.sh runs the same checks.

features.name: Taipei 1999 data ingestion and privacy-preserving UI
features.description: Convert local/fetched Open1999 data, publish sanitized JSON, and render district, hotspot, list, and dashboard views.
features.evidence: public/data contains sanitized generated JSON; browser verification confirmed map/district circles render without console errors.

features.name: GitHub Pages deployment workflow
features.description: Build, test, upload, and deploy the static Vite app through GitHub Pages on main pushes and manual dispatches.
features.evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml added; npm run build:pages passed and dist/index.html uses /taipei-1999-map/ asset paths.

features.name: Agent harness and handoff maintenance
features.description: Keep AGENTS.md, feature_list.json, progress.md, init.sh, and session-handoff.md current for future coding-agent sessions.
features.evidence: Harness validation scored 100/100; ./init.sh passed npm test and npm run build.

features.name: Review and cleanup pass
features.description: Run code review and anti-slop cleanup on the deployment/data changes while preserving behavior.
features.evidence: Invalid time parsing, duplicate case ID publishing, and empty top-group display were fixed; 12 tests passed.

features.name: Taipei streetlight repair data module
features.description: Fetch, convert, summarize, and display Taipei streetlight repair records as a privacy-preserving district-level service data module.
features.evidence: Fetched official streetlight CSV resources, converted 65,022 deduplicated records, added React/Leaflet module, and verified with npm test, npm run build, npm run build:pages, and static browser smoke testing.

features.name: Public works construction audit module
features.description: Fetch, convert, summarize, and display Taipei City Government construction audit records as a standalone public-works oversight module.
features.evidence: Fetched 17 official quarterly CSV resources, converted 718 construction audit records, added no-map dashboard module, and verified with tests, builds, and browser smoke testing.

features.name: Construction stop and resume work module
features.description: Fetch, convert, summarize, and display Taipei construction stop/resume work public information as a standalone labor-safety oversight module.
features.evidence: Fetched the official CSV, converted 1,043 deduplicated stop/resume records from uploaded and official CSVs, added no-map dashboard module, and verified with tests, builds, and browser smoke testing.

features.name: Cross-platform agent harness startup
features.description: Keep agent startup reproducible on Bash and Windows PowerShell, including dependency bootstrap and matching verification checks.
features.evidence: Added dependency bootstrapping and matching Bash/PowerShell startup checks, and verified 27 tests plus npm run build; structural harness validation remains 100/100.

features.name: API-key-free map tiles
features.description: Use a public map tile source that does not render an API-key-required watermark while preserving required attribution.
features.evidence: Switched both Leaflet maps from unauthenticated CARTO raster tiles to the official OpenStreetMap tile endpoint with visible OSM contributor attribution; tests and production build passed.

features.name: Chinese-mode project-wide display audit
features.description: Audit and localize all visible Chinese-mode labels, descriptions, data units, dates, periods, status values, and chart/table display fields across every module.
features.evidence: Localized base-app labels and accessibility text, construction currency/role labels, quarter/month/date/hour values, streetlight status fallbacks, and popup headings; added i18n regression tests. npm test passed 30 tests and npm run build passed.

features.name: Bilingual project documentation
features.description: Maintain separate English and Traditional Chinese README documentation with synchronized setup, data, privacy, module, map, deployment, and limitation guidance.
features.evidence: Replaced the mixed-language README with an English README.md and added a parallel Traditional Chinese README-zh.md covering the same project guidance.

features.name: PWA update refresh for map tile changes
features.description: Ensure deployed app-shell updates replace stale service-worker content so changed map tile sources appear without a manual cache purge.
features.evidence: Versioned the PWA cache, removed obsolete caches during activation, enabled immediate client takeover, added network-first refresh for app assets/data, and triggered service-worker update checks on page load.

features.name: Automatic deployed app refresh
features.description: Reload controlled PWA windows when a new service worker activates so deployed map-source changes appear without a manual hard refresh.
features.evidence: Service-worker activation now claims clients and navigates controlled windows to the current URL after obsolete-cache cleanup; public app/data requests refresh from the network first.
